CORRECTION_LOG.trigger: Objective impossibility discovered during Step 1 verification (before any generation/evaluation call): all three originally-selected ChEMBL case_ids (CHEMBL-search_by_target-CHEMBL6329, CHEMBL6328, CHEMBL265667) carry gold.expected_skip=true in artifacts/v2/phase5_benchmark_manifest.json (expected_skip_reason: 'no_real_content_moa_and_name_both_placeholder_or_absent') - the raw record's name field is null AND mechanism_of_action is the literal placeholder 'Not available'. Per evidence/adapters.py's own chembl_target_or_indication_result_to_evidence, this means the adapter returns None (no Evidence record at all) for every one of these three records. Generating a claim citing these records is impossible, not just weak - there is no Evidence to cite. Using them would silently produce zero ChEMBL evidence, defeating the entire purpose of this supplement (restoring ChEMBL representation, the exact gap that reopened CTL-011).
CORRECTION_LOG.remediation: Enumerated the full universe of ChEMBL records in phase5_benchmark_manifest.json (20 total). Applying the plan's own pre-existing exclusion rules (no phase5_heldout split, no record already used anywhere in Phase 6/Phase 7) plus the newly-discovered non-skip requirement, exactly two distinct usable ChEMBL compounds remain in the entire manifest: CHEMBL25 (aspirin, validation split, chembl_operation=resolve_compound_name, evidence_type=compound_identity) and CHEMBL3137343 (Keytruda/pembrolizumab, validation split, same operation/type). ('CHEMBL-resolve-asprin' is the same underlying CHEMBL25 compound as 'CHEMBL-resolve-aspirin' - a real-world source duplicate - so only one of the pair was used.) No third distinct, non-skip, non-excluded ChEMBL compound exists, so Q-MS2's chembl half could not be filled without either reusing CHEMBL25/CHEMBL3137343 again (source duplication) or violating an exclusion. Q-MS2 was therefore rebuilt as a two-pubmed-source multi_source case (both real, distinct pmids, unused anywhere in Phase 6/Phase 7) instead of forcing a third, invalid or duplicated ChEMBL selection.
CORRECTION_LOG.scope_of_correction: This changes WHICH real records are used for Q-CH1, Q-CH2, and Q-MS2's second half. It does not change the target_source_category_quotas (chembl remains 2, multi_source remains 2), the generation architecture, the evaluation plan, or any exclusion rule. No case was substituted after seeing any generated answer or evaluator output - this correction was made purely from static gold-label/adapter-behavior inspection, before any generation or evaluation call for this supplement.
